verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent-observability SaaS with a CLI and API, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows generic authentication: an OTel exporter using "one auth header" and `bentolabs auth login` saving tokens to the keychain. Nothing documents scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent credential issuance, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
